# Ulla Davidsen

Ulla Davidsen is a senior physician ("Overlæge") with an MPK qualification who serves on the steering committee of the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) national quality database, based at [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]][^src1][^src2]. She appears in the steering committee listings of two consecutive AFDK annual reports, covering the period from 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, and again in the following year's report[^src1][^src2].

The 2023 annual report entry appears in the chapter covering the database's data foundation — patient population definitions, data collection limitations, and the composition of the steering committee — for the reporting period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023[^src1]. The 2024 report entry appears in a section (pages 66–70) that documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has implemented systematic patient education since 2012, and again lists the steering committee's members alongside key methodological limitations of the database[^src2]. AFDK operates as Denmark's nationwide quality database for atrial fibrillation treatment, under the auspices of the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and with approval from Sundhedsstyrelsen[^src2].

No further biographical detail, claims, or timeline events involving Ulla Davidsen are present in the corpus beyond her steering committee role and hospital affiliation.
